event_name: Date 29 April 2018 Time 17:18 2018 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 9 collided with car 20 in turn 2.
incident_time: Penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 4 points in total for the 12 month period)
offence: Causing a collision in breach of Article 2d of Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and the driver of car 9 caused a collision with car 20. The driver of car 9 locked up and collided with car 20. The Stewards determined that the driver of car 9 was wholly to blame for the collision. Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Tom Kristensen Anar Shukurov
title: 2018 Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018 Offence Car 9 Causing A Collision With Car 20 In T2 Doc 33
